backend: LLVM 21.1.8 and LLD 21.1.8 with precompiled Rust 1.85.1 runtimes
acceptance_criterion: On a supported clean machine with no Go installation, an installed Lo distribution can compile and link a representative program offline, and the resulting executable runs without Lo installed.

environments.darwin: macOS 27.0.1 / Darwin arm64; sandbox excludes source checkout and preparation tools, denies network and external writes; inherited restrictions verified by compiled guard.
environments.linux: QEMU 11.1.2 TCG; Linux 6.12.110 / glibc 2.36 arm64; no network interface or host mounts; installed package, source, base libraries and initializer only.
environments.artifact_execution: Separate Darwin sandbox or Linux guest contains the artifact and declared OS dependencies, without Lo, the package, source, or compiler tools.
environments.metal: Separate Darwin package compiled and executed a CPU representative with Metal linkage; changed kernels rejected. I010 supplies controlled device semantic evidence.

installed_matrix.details: Manifest, tool, linker, runtime, platform, kernel, and Linux library rejection; preserved output; empty staging; second relocation; exported artifact length and SHA-256.

runtime_regression.scope: Development CLI with packaged LLVM inputs. All final packages have identical frontend and manifest bytes to the initial packages used for this regression. Installed CLI isolation is verified separately.

linux_library_snapshots.environment: Network-free Linux arm64 QEMU TCG guest

deterministic_cleanup.evidence: Passed in both final CI lanes. A controlled compiler execution witness precedes failure or cancellation. Existing output and empty staging are verified.

limits: I011 retains the full installed-language corpus qualification and removal of development Go generation.
The frontend is a prebuilt Go executable. Consumers need no Go installation.
Physical Metal execution and performance remain unmeasured; software validation is sufficient for acceptance.
Linux process execution retains its existing unavailable result.
Artifact application features retain declared capabilities and operating-system dependencies.
